name: ProGroCo | 1g x 3 Bubble Hash Infused Multi-Pack | Orange Push Pop
description: Experience the full power of Michigan’s elite genetics with the Pro Gro Infused 3-Pack. Each pack contains three 1g pre-rolls, offering a substantial 3 grams of total product. Because bubble hash is a solventless concentrate (extracted using only ice and water), these joints maintain a clean, authentic flavor profile while delivering a massive boost in THC and minor cannabinoids.
